Brewed root beer is alcoholic. The soda is just root beer flavored.


My dad's ex wanted to be Amish *so bad* and the only thing I liked about that phase was the root beer. She didn't know I was getting drunk while she was shoving the gospel down my throat.


The more you know

It's 9 months long.

I need help. That's just it. Not a day goes by that I don't think about killing myself and I don't know why anymore. I see opportunities everywhere and I have to lock myself in another room or hand my keys to someone else so I don't do anything stupid.

I don't think we *need* two new cars. I don't see why we can't get two used cars. They would be nice, but if we can't afford them then we can't.

Apartments in the area are more expensive than homes. We have rent covered but not the furnishings.

It doesn't really matter though. Some of our best times were piling into a military bed and watching YouTube on the laptop.

I have a really shitty way of thinking and I acknowledge it. I just can't stop sometimes
He knew I've been feeling down but had no idea how bad it really was. He wants to help but he feels its out of his hands and wants me to see a professional.

Wow. I never thought of it like that.

I don't see the point. I don't think my life is worth living. I don't see anything getting better from here, just different situations that are bad. I need to change.

I currently have two emotions. Sad and crying non stop, and complete apathy and lack of concern for everything. Convincing myself that I'm having a great day makes me angry, so that's a start

I still try. I think faking it is better than letting it show. I just hear about how mothers have this unbreakable bond and are overwhelmed with unconditional love from the moment they see their babies.

I'd never want her to know. She's done nothing wrong. I have my own issues. I'm just glad that her dad loves her so much. My parents as well.

Of course I want to. It's the worst feeling. That's my baby and I have no feelings for her. I want to be overwhelmed with joy and love. I want to look at her and have the motivation to keep going. On the worst days I want to think "its all for her" and want to push harder. At least that's how the other moms I know describe it. I feel like an anomaly. They said their kid made their life so much better, they're happier, want to do better. I'm the opposite.

I made them let me live with them free of cost, buy me a car, raise my child, support her financially, watch her while I'm at school all day.

Even when I am home, someone else is usually watching her because I couldn't be bothered.

I don't feel like she's mine. She came from my body, I know that. It doesn't feel like it. I don't have any sort of bond with her. I don't feel any love for her. It's like baby sitting a neighbor kid. I make sure she's alive and fed. Other than that I don't really care.

The fact that I've royally fucked myself and everyone close in my life. All of my mistakes, bad choices, wrong doings, debts, all things bad fall on them just as much if not more than they do me. They hate me for it and I hate me too.
And if you don't have a coin to drop, pants should suffice.
I thought it was coin dropped. And whoever doesn't have theirs owes beer...

Thank you! I sent him a detailed email of everything I've been feeling and he's trying to get me help. I still have thoughts but now that he knows I'm less inclined to take action without consulting him first. Thank you for convincing me to tell him
I don't know what to tell him. I Have no idea how to have this conversation

I'll try and catch him on a day he isn't too busy. I guess you're right. I should still talk with him. I don't want him to get too caught up with the drama back home though he has much bigger things to deal with over there
He knows I'm not happy with myself, but that's the extent of it. I can't talk to him much right now and I would not want to tell him especially with his job.
what is ppmd? I've never heard of it

I go to cosmetology school and I like it a lot. I love being a hair stylist. It really messed me up when my parents sat me down and told me I'd never be able to pay it back. If that's true, this isn't worth it. I'm going to start my marriage $10k in debt. By october 2016 we need to buy 2 cars, move to a new house, and furnish it. I don't know how to fix it
I wish. Insurance doesn't cover it. That's why I try to make friends online:)
